INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – August 25, 2021

The Inglewood Library Board met on August 25, 2021 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 4:30 p.m. by
Board Member Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Isaac Yoshinaga – Actin Senior Library Support Supervisor
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Minton made a motion for the approval of the minutes for July 28, 2021
  Board Member Douglas seconded the motion. Minutes were approved as follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Minton, Douglas and Cochran
  Nays: None

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh gave the board members Library’s update
  After having an internal recruitment, Kerri Arroyo was selected as the new Library Manager. Senior
  management team, two principal librarians and one acting senior library support supervisor, are reporting to
  the Library Manager. One principal librarian covers the Crenshaw library and children’s services at the Main
  library. The other principal librarian covers the adult and technical services at the Main library. The acting

  1
   senior library support supervisor is Isaac Yoshinaga who covers the entire library support section, which
  means all none librarian staff reports to him.
  Isaac Yoshinaga introduced himself and spoke about his experience, work, library operations,
  accomplishments, improvements, staffing. He’s also working on library policies and procedures.
  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh also added that right now we are working on a new telephone
  tree to make sure that people get maximum customer service. No phone calls will be dropped, not
  answered or transferred. And because staff is cross trained, no matter where the phone call goes in the
  library, everyone will get help without being transferred. Also, the clerks on each floor will greet and help
  patrons at the library to find the material that they are looking for, put books back on the shelf. The librarian
  will have the iPad and will help patrons that need a lot more information in depth.

Public Comments

  None

Friends Report

  None

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board members congratulate and thanked Isaac Yoshinaga for his great service.
  Board member Minton asked about Library renovation.
  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh answered that we acquired approval in the budget to start the
  Main Library renovation project in December of 2021.
  Board member Cochran asked about the hearing regarding the Library being fine free.
  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh said the hearing went well. After getting an explanation on how
  important it is that the library be fine free, city manager, council members and mayor wanted this to happen
  and were very happy with all the changes. We have some key changes in staffing, have approvals to add
  more positions in the budget. All those changes will be presented to council in October, in the new fiscal
  year.
  All Board members thanked Mr. Singh and were very happy with the library report.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:05 p.m.
